sources.read_scope: All nine original scan pages 1154–1162 visually read, including Figures1–5, Tables1–2, methods, discussion and references.
findings: Native Pseudomonas testosteroni PDC hydrolase was purified from 4-hydroxybenzoate-grown cells; Figure1 proposes hemiacetal oxidation and explicitly says its three open-chain isomeric forms were not individually characterized.
Hydrolase interconversion is reversible and pH-dependent. At 1mM, Zn2+, Cu2+, Mn2+ and Co2+ inhibit; Mg2+ and EDTA neither activate nor inhibit. EDTA stabilizes diluted enzyme.

0.1mM DTNB abolishes measured hydrolase activity; 5mM reduced glutathione present during DTNB incubation preserves activity. This is protection under treatment, not demonstrated recovery of pre-inactivated enzyme.

P.putida PDC metabolizes PDC through downstream activities but uses ortho cleavage for protocatechuate. P.putida TMC lacks PDC hydrolase; neither supports assigning the entire P184 route to P.putida generally.
Figures4–5 include alternative gallic/3-O-methylgallic reactions. They are contextual branches and do not establish the exact modern enol stereochemistry of the protocatechuate route.

sources.read_scope: Full main article HTML, all five tables and all nine figure rasters read. Six inline mathematical equation rasters not independently viewed; no quantitative equation reconstruction claimed.
findings: Experiments compare KT2440 GalB with Comamonas sp.E6 PmdE/LigJ (BAI50711.1), not directly SYK6 LigJ. Both use GalD-generated (2E,4E)-CHM and yield (−)-CHA; Figure9 S-CHA is a modeled assignment explicitly lacking absolute-configuration measurement.

GalD retained its His6 tag because of an internal thrombin site. Codon-optimized PmdE carried an N-terminal His6 tag removed with thrombin; residual cleavage sequence was not established here. Crystallized GalB lacks four N-terminal residues; other kinetics use separate wild-type/variant preparations.

GalB was expressed in E.coli and its native host KT2442. Zinc predominated after aerobic purification; physiological metal identity remains unresolved. Fe2+/Co2+ rescue apoenzyme; Table2 gives lesser activities with other metals. EDTA inactivates. Reversible CHA/CHM and HMG/CHPD assays and pH/mutant data do not imply identical physiological substrates or native constructs.
SYK6 pathway inference from homologs and complementation must be separated from direct E6 biochemistry. Whole-KT2440 protocatechuate meta-cleavage is not demonstrated.

sources.read_scope: Complete Europe PMC primary abstract and exact current UniProt Q0KJL4/G2IQQ5 structured records; ACS full text403, thesis downloads403, figshare endpoint empty202, STRENDA response was a search shell.
findings: The abstract reports LigU allylic isomerization from (4E)-OMA to (3Z)-KCH, followed by LigJ hydration. This is chemically distinct from an OMA→CHM keto-enol step.

The paper title names SYK6, but the indexed methods lead identifies Q0KJL4 and the current issuing authority maps Q0KJL4 to Novosphingobium KA1. Do not treat the title as proof that the actual synthetic LigU was SYK6.
Full construct sequence, expression tag and coupling conditions were not read; proposed changes require those details or a genuinely narrower qualified claim.

Separate mutant and wild-type materials; no construct sequence or tag details inferred from abstract. Current G2IQQ5 activity is RHEA58508 (CHEBI142690 plus water to CHEBI142706).

sources.read_scope: Complete Europe PMC primary abstract; full methods/figures not acquired.
findings: This later LigU study explicitly identifies Novosphingobium KA1, consistent with Q0KJL4. It reports a homodimer without required cofactors/metals and a suprafacial isomerization mechanism.

sources.read_scope: Complete Europe PMC primary abstract only; no full main article or supplement acquired.
findings: KT2440 derivative gal genes establish gallate transport and GalD/GalB/GalC downstream metabolism. GalT is gallate-specific transport, not evidence for protocatechuate transport.

The abstract calls GalD a keto-enol tautomerase and GalB a zinc-containing hydratase. No full protocatechuate pathway, exact tagged construct or exact product stereochemistry should be inferred from it.

sources.read_scope: Complete primary abstract and issuing UniProt Q9KWL3; full HTML routes challenged and XML metadata-only.
findings: Recombinant SYK6 LigC is dimeric and produces PDC with NADP; both NADP and NAD support assay. Abstract Km values: NADP24.6μM, NAD252μM, CHMS26.0μM with NADP and20.6μM with NAD.
Current UniProt kinetic substrate labels transpose these four assignments. Preserve primary-source values; do not replay mislabeled authority kinetic fields as verified measurements.
Disruption/complementation supports vanillate catabolism; proposed PDC induction does not prove direct regulator binding.
